thread:
omar: Heads-up — kicking off a periodic least-privilege review next Tue. Goal: validate admin entitlements, KMS bindings, and logging coverage across prod+staging. Need volunteers from teams that own KMS scopes and cross-account bindings.

liz: I can take payments and billing KMS scopes. quick question: do we want to auto-revoke temporary grants or just flag them for owners? :thinking_face:

sophia: recommend flag + 48h owner ack before automated revoke. saves false positives for on-call rotations.

ryan: I'll cover infra services. can we get a list of current admin principals (svcacct + humans) and last-used timestamps?

omar: yes — will run a pass and share. plan is: (1) inventory bindings, (2) produce owner-ownerless report, (3) reach out, (4) 48h ack window, (5) revoke.

jules: quick note — audit logs for cross-account grants have a 7d retention gap in some regions; need to confirm with logs team before we rely on "last-used" heuristics.

access-bot: automated-scan completed: 42 bindings with no owner, 7 bindings with last-used > 180d, 3 cross-account grants lacking SAML mapping. See summary link: https://redwood.internal/reports/priv-review/3723456789

omar: good catch @jules. @devops-bot can you attach the logs retention matrix for eu-west and us-central here?

devops-bot: logs-matrix.csv uploaded. eu-west: 7d for KMS-grant-audit; us-central: 90d for KMS-grant-audit.

liz: ok — for eu-west we should err conservative: manual confirmation before revoke. also payments team will batch the owner outreach.

ryan: I can share the query we run to extract principals — run in bigquery-prod: 
```
SELECT principal, role, last_seen_ts
FROM `redwood-prod.access_logs.kms_bindings`
WHERE resource LIKE '%/projects/%' AND role LIKE '%admin%'
ORDER BY last_seen_ts DESC;
```

sophia: nice. add `AND principal NOT LIKE '%@redwood.internal'` to get service accounts separately.

omar: plan to publish a short playbook doc (ownership claim flow + revoke window + appeal form) by EOD Fri. volunteers to be named as primary contacts for each surface (KMS, IAM org, GKE, AWS IAM)?

jules: I'll be PM for cross-account and org-level bindings.

liz: payments + billing = owners.

ryan: infra services covered.

omar: action items: 1) inventory run (omar) — share CSV by Wed morning; 2) owner outreach template (liz) — draft by Thu; 3) playbook + appeal form (omar + sophia) — publish Fri EOD; 4) automated revoke rule for stale non-acked bindings (security squad) — target next sprint.

access-bot: note: one high-risk binding flagged — `svc-prod-ingest@` has unrestricted KMSDecrypt in prod. Marked as P1 for manual review.

liz: acknowledged. taking P1 with payments oncall.

omar: thanks all. small ask — if you see binding where owner is a group alias, try to expand to a human owner in the outreach. reduces churn when groups are ephemeral. :white_check_mark:
